Now that we have trace_bprintk() which is faster and consume lesser
memory than trace_printk() and has the same purpose
the old implementation in favour of the binary one from trace_bprintk()
which means we move all the implementation of trace_bprintk() to
trace_printk()
column2: so the Api doesn't change except that we must now use

column1: trace_seq_bprintk() to print the TRACE_PRINT entries.

- Previously
column2: trace_bprintk depended of a single tracer and couldn't

column1: work without. This tracer has been dropped and the whole implementation
of trace_printk() (like the module formats management) is now integrated
in the tracing core (comes with CONFIG_TRACING)
trace_printk (previously trace_bprintk.c) where we can find the module
management. Thus we don't overflow trace.c
